title: V01-C03 Problem Definition and Decomposition Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A bounded problem contract that identifies stakeholder, outcome, inputs, outputs, constraints, assumptions, non-goals, acceptance criteria and edge cases; plus a responsibility decomposition with explicit dependencies and an evidence-based defense of decisions.

accessibility_requirements: Every diagram has an equivalent ordered text description.
Tables use descriptive headers and do not rely on color.
Interactive activities are keyboard operable and have static alternatives.
Animations, if produced later, include pause and reduced-motion alternatives.
Turkish technical terms include English at first meaningful use.
Learner instructions use short steps and explicit deliverables.
known_risks: Requirements-engineering vocabulary may create excessive cognitive load for a beginner.
Edge case, boundary case and invalid input may be incorrectly treated as synonyms.
Learners may mistake decomposition for an arbitrary task list.
AI may invent requirements or prematurely select a solution.
Expanded candidate sources require canonical Source and Evidence registration before Stable publication.
Independent technical and pedagogical review plus a beginner pilot remain pending.
